dek: September 26's full moon in Aries hits every sign with a jolt of raw confidence.

slides.label: What Happened
slides.text: On September 26 at 12:49PM EDT, a *full moon in Aries* lit up the sky at 03°37', paired with Neptune.

slides.label: The Vibe
slides.text: This full moon delivers *unapologetic confidence*, pushing you to show up loud, bold and fully yourself.

slides.label: The Catch
slides.text: Aries craves being Number One, so watch the line between *empowered and entitled* self-advocacy.

slides.label: Neptune's Pull
slides.text: Neptune sits close to the moon, unlocking *bottled-up emotions*, so lean on friends or therapy to process them.

slides.label: Sign by Sign
slides.text: Every zodiac sign gets a specific push, from Aries broadcasting a passion project to Pisces tightening up money habits.

slides.label: Harvest Timing
slides.text: This is the year's only *Full Harvest Moon* in Aries, meaning whatever you plant now grows fast over two weeks.

slides.label: What's Next
slides.text: The next full moon lands October 26 in Taurus; the next Aries full moon isn't until *October 2027*.

slides.label: Why It Matters
slides.text: For underrepresented creators and founders, this moon is permission to post the project, pitch the idea, own the room, no waiting for approval.
